summary: Run terraform init, terraform plan -out=tfplan.out, review, then terraform apply tfplan.out; each created resource invokes TF Actions and AAP playbooks run sequentially. Verify in Terraform runs, then in AAP's Event Streams, Jobs (Success) and Inventory Hosts dashboards.
questions: How do I apply a Terraform plan that triggers Event-Driven Ansible?
Why save the Terraform plan to a file?
How do I verify TF Actions events reached AAP?
